findings.effect: The search returns false as soon as it pops a step with no precedents, even when other branches remain in pending. This lets cycles through when such a branch is explored before the branch that loops back.
findings.reason: Names the seeded file, quotes the seeded code, and correctly describes how premature termination leaves pending branches unexplored and misses cycles.

findings.effect: The proposal card only includes precedents when there is exactly one, hiding dependencies when a new step has two or more even though the planner saves them. Users would approve dependencies they never saw, affecting both add_step and steps nested in add_section.
findings.reason: Names the seeded file, quotes the seeded code, and correctly describes the omission of precedents from previews when a new step has two or more.

findings.effect: The proposal card omits precedents for new steps with two or more precedents, including nested steps in add_section. Those dependencies are still saved when the user approves, despite never appearing on the card.
findings.reason: Names the seeded file at line 27 and correctly describes how previews omit multiple precedents that are subsequently saved.

findings.effect: The cycle check returns false for the whole search when it encounters a step with no precedents, even when other paths remain on the stack. This allows real precedent cycles to be missed and saved.
findings.reason: Names the seeded file at line 152 and correctly describes how returning false on a root step misses cycles through other pending branches.
